stores.verification: sector_brain_platform.knowledge_release: per-file sha256 and bytes plus release digest; then the projection's own schema, count and digest
stores.lineage: knowledgeRelease in the registry; knowledgeRelease, manifestRef and manifestSha256 in the artifact lineage

knowledge.notes: The release is a projection (lakeId, name, state, lat, lon) of the Engine's compiled lake directory, the registry.lakes contract; a test fails when it drifts from Sources/SectorEngine/Support/LakeDirectory.swift. The ephemeris is code (sector-moon-v1), not knowledge.

operations.internalExecution: none: not scheduled, no executor (control manifest PARKED, executionTarget kind none) and absent from the execution control (disabled). run.py writes a local file or an in-memory dry run only; --write refuses.

execution.refresh: registered disabled: no schedule (control manifest schedule MANUAL, triggers MANUAL/ADMIN only); a run happens only on an explicit request. The enablement target is TIME (nightly, then hourly with Weather cloud cover), set together with the manifest schedule when the owner enables it (docs/brains/MOON_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 7.1)
execution.controlledBy: fam.control-execution-control (global + per-Brain; fail closed; read by the orchestrator only). The Moon Brain is not in it: disabled.

operations.notes: Owner decision 2026-11-22 (Sector_Ops #51): build it. Merging changes nothing at runtime: PARKED, no executor, no live writer, customerPublication false (PRE_PRODUCTION). The Weather Brain cloud input is OPTIONAL: the Weather state sector-brain-weather-state-v1 (cloud rows only; contracts/moon-night-light-v1.json weatherInput), declared in consumes once Weather is on main.
